title: [Bug] "Remote Control failed" error during execution
body: **Bug Description** I'm running pro plan and trying to use "Remote Control." However I'm getting "Remote Control failed" error when trying to use it. Both for the slash command and the cli flag. I've logged out and back in twice, and restarted my laptop. Mac **Environment Info** - OS: MacOS Sequoia 15.7.3 - Platform: darwin - Terminal: iTerm.app - Version: 2.1.63 - Feedback ID: 6eb16869-4ef0-4c92-bbf1-95dbe76ebf81 **Errors**
author: jcdeichmann
